thread:
acme_prod_team: We started seeing weird translations after the update at 22:12Z. Asked 'Como inicio sessão no painel?' and got a full English reply: 'To log in, go to the dashboard and click login.' That used to be Portuguese with local phrasing. Also Hindi inputs are returning romanized output. Please help.
maria_cs: Thanks for flagging — opening escalation. Can you paste example request IDs and payloads?
acme_prod_team: Request id resp_9f8d3: payload snippet:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
{
  "model": "redwood-7b-quant-v2026-03-14",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Explique como configuro regras de segurança no painel"}],
  "accept_language": "pt-BR"
}
Response:
{"id":"resp_9f8d3","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"To configure security rules, go to Settings > Security..."}}]}
lena_support: acked. Did this start right after the canary window? Which variant was in canary?
deploy-bot: canary start 2026-03-14T22:05:03Z target: redwood-7b-quant-v2026-03-14 traffic: 25% changes: kernel: attn-v2 rollout, kv-cache refactor
tom_runtime: logs show canary at 25%. ops, did you see any 5xx around 22:10-22:30Z?
girish_ops: small spike in 502s between 22:08 and 22:30Z. Paused the canary at 22:42Z after customer reports.
cheng_ml: initial read: kv-cache snapshotting race with new attn-v2 kernels can duplicate or shift system prompt tokens. If system prompt duplicates or gets reinserted mid-stream, it might cause the model to output in the system language (English) instead of honoring accept_language.
maria_cs: customer also reports Hindi Devanagari input -> Latin romanization output and honorifics missing (no "ji"/respect markers). They are pretty upset.
lena_support: they want rollback or a routing pin to older model ASAP.
tom_runtime: I've added a per-account routing override for Acme to redwood-7b-quant-v2026-02-27; change should propagate within ~60s.
acme_prod_team: Confirmed — Portuguese responses returned at 22:45Z. Thanks. But their client retried failed requests earlier and they saw a billing bump. Can we flag finance?
maria_cs: filing finance alert.
cheng_ml: I reproduced locally by toggling kv-cache snapshot enabled + attn-v2. Repro steps:
```
# repro
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-quant-v2026-03-14","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant that responds in the user's language."},{"role":"user","content":"Como inicio sessão no painel?"}]}'
```
Observed intermittent English output. Model logs show duplicated system prompt tokens injected after the first user token when kv-cache snapshot raced with first request chunk.
cheng_ml: hypothesis: kv-cache snapshot race condition + attn-v2 windowing changes lead to token index misalignment and unintended system prompt precedence. Hindi romanization likely due to tokenizer fallback path when script detection fails mid-stream.
lena_support: mitigation options: 1) pause canary (done), 2) route affected customers to pinned older model (done for Acme), 3) push hotfix to kv-cache snapshot logic and restart canary nodes.
girish_ops: after pause and rollback of canary nodes, 502 spike subsided.
cheng_ml: I'll add unit tests for kv-cache snapshot atomicity and script-aware tokenizer checks (Devanagari, Hangul, Cyrillic). A hotfix to snapshot order should land tomorrow morning, then we'll run targeted language canary tests (Portuguese + Hindi heavy).
maria_cs: please also add a canary evaluation that runs locale-preservation checks for any kernel-level changes before ramping traffic beyond 10%.
cheng_ml: agreed. Plan: add automated language-fidelity tests to canary pipeline (50% pt, 30% hi, 20% others). We'll assert language detection and presence of locale-specific tokens.
lena_support: follow-ups: (1) confirm Acme routing pin persisted (tom_runtime) (2) finance billing investigation (maria_cs) (3) ML fix + tests (cheng_ml) (4) CS write customer note + timeline (lena_support).
maria_cs: customer asked for a timeline and a formal postmortem once root cause confirmed. Creating INC-2026-1423 and linking this thread.
cheng_ml: adding logs and repro to INC-2026-1423. Will notify when patch is in canary and when language-focused canary passes.
maria_cs: thanks team — customer is calmer but wants assurance. Will update Acme with rollback confirmation and planned fixes.
